title: HB1041 (2019 Regular): provide for the carrying of a concealed pistol without a permit.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (South Dakota) (gun-policy Stage 5, South Dakota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Dakota text (Introduced, 2019-01-11; official copy, https://mylrc.sdlegislature.gov/api/Documents/51601.pdf (sdlegislature.gov DocumentId 51601, BillId 9724))
provenance.note: As filed 2019-01-11. No passage vote recorded. Sections 6, 8-11 are conforming edits (temporary permit wording, reciprocity cross-reference, struck permit-holder carry sentence in 23-7-8.1, grace period, pistol delivery); struck text not quoted. operative_text:
Section 5 (SDCL 23-7-7): The issuance of a permit to carry a concealed pistol pursuant to this chapter or the recognition of nonresident permits to carry a concealed pistol under § 23-7-7.4 do not impose a general prohibition on the carry of a pistol without a permit.
Section 7 (SDCL 23-7-7.4): Any valid permit to carry a concealed pistol, issued to a nonresident of South Dakota, is valid in South Dakota according to the terms of its issuance in the state of its issue, but only to the extent that the terms of issuance comply with any appropriate South Dakota statute or promulgated rule.
Section 12 (new section in SDCL ch. 23-7): No person may carry a concealed pistol in any licensed on-sale malt beverage or alcoholic beverage establishment that derives over one-half of its total income from the sale of malt or alcoholic beverages.
